messages:
Mia Chen: opening a PR to add a short 'parse fallback' cheat-sheet and a compact example for function/tool calling outputs. goal: give SDK users a minimal migration note + quick code examples.
Garret Li: love it. can you include a tiny JS + py snippet that shows a robust fallback path for union/nulls? say 3-4 lines.
Elaine Rodriguez: i'll handle the SDK v2 snippet. prefer to keep the JSON sample very small — no $id, keep union examples explicit.
Sanjay Patel: also add a single line about guardrails: explicit type hints in the prompt + validate before calling downstream code. maybe an example of failing-safe parse.
Mia Chen: good call. i'll add a short migration paragraph referencing the new parsing helpers in the SDK and link to the parse-runbook. PR soon.
Garret Li: quick nit: show both 'structured' and 'loose' parsing examples. e.g., try jsonschema validate -> fallback to regex/heuristic.
Elaine Rodriguez: here's a suggested snippet to include in the docs:
```
# python fallback example
try:
    parsed = jsonschema.validate(output, schema)
except ValidationError:
    # fallback: attempt simple extraction
    parsed = heuristic_extract(output)
```

and js:
```
// js fallback
let parsed;
try { parsed = validate(output, schema); } catch(e) { parsed = heuristicExtract(output); }
```

Sanjay Patel: add a tiny JSON schema example for the docs (compact):
```
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": "string"},
    "args": {"type": ["object", "null"]}
  },
  "required": ["action"]
}
```

Mia Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — posting checklist in the PR. cc @docs-bot
docs-bot: PR label applied: docs, needs-review
Garret Li: i'll review after lunch. can we add one sentence about 'prefer canonical shapes to minimize ambiguity'?
Elaine Rodriguez: added the SDK link and a short migration note in the PR description.
Mia Chen: thanks all — i'll merge after reviewers+CI. if anyone has examples to add, drop them in the PR or ping me.
